title: UP Anganwadi Bharti 2026 – Current District-wise Vacancies
organization: Uttar Pradesh Anganwadi Recruitment Portal / ICDS
postName: Anganwadi Worker / Helper / Mini Anganwadi posts (district-wise)
vacancyDetails: No single combined vacancy is published on the portal. Current district-wise Worker and Helper notices include Balrampur, Hamirpur, Fatehpur, Azamgarh, Banda, Chitrakoot, Jhansi and other districts as listed on the official portal.
qualification: 12th Pass (Intermediate) – as per post and district notification; local residence criteria apply
ageLimit: As per UP Anganwadi / WCD district recruitment rules
applicationFee: Check the concerned district notice and application portal; no universal fee is stated for all districts.
selectionProcess: Merit based on educational marks / local criteria → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: Educational certificates (12th marksheet), photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable, residence proof
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP WCD / district Anganwadi recruitment portal
2. Select district and post (Worker/Helper)
3. Register and fill form with local documents
4. Upload certificates and submit
5. Track merit list on district portal
statusNote: District-wise active notices are available; dates and posts differ by district.
shortDescription: UP Anganwadi Worker and Helper Bharti 2026 is being published district-wise. Check the current official portal listing for active notices, district deadlines and post-specific eligibility.
content:
UP Anganwadi Recruitment Portal is publishing district-wise notices for Anganwadi Worker (AWW) and Anganwadi Helper (AWH) vacancies.

The current portal listing includes active notices for districts such as Balrampur, Hamirpur, Fatehpur, Azamgarh, Banda, Chitrakoot and Jhansi, with additional districts shown on the portal. Each notice has its own post, centre, eligibility and closing date.

Current portal snapshot

  • Balrampur Worker and Helper notice: uploaded 03 September 2026; last date 23 September 2026.
  • Hamirpur Worker notice: uploaded 27 August 2026; last date 16 September 2026.
  • Fatehpur Worker notice: uploaded 27 August 2026; last date 19 September 2026.
  • Azamgarh Worker notice: uploaded 12 August 2026; last date 14 September 2026.
  • Banda Worker notice: last date 22 September 2026.
  • Chitrakoot Worker notice: last date 05 September 2026.
  • Jhansi Worker notice: last date 07 September 2026.

These are district-wise listings, not one statewide vacancy count. Read the concerned notice, confirm residence and educational conditions, and apply through the portal shown for that district.
